description: Migration class for updating database schema and data for OrangeHRM version 5.2.0, including schema changes, data cleanup, language string updates, and configuration adjustments.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema migrations for OrangeHRM version 5.2.0, including schema updates, data cleanup, and configuration management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration actions: schema updates, data cleaning, language strings updates, configuration adjustments.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the migration, which is '5.2.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for language string management.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the left menu configuration for the PIM module to use the new menu configurator class.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organization structure based on the organization info in the database.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for a given user role.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts LDAP configuration menu item into the menu structure.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Deletes LDAP addon related data from the database.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Reads notes from a YAML file and updates language string notes accordingly.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Removes specific internationalization groups and reassigns or deletes associated language strings.
